auth.label: Access Token
auth.description: Tenant-scoped LoyJoy access token. Create one in LoyJoy Manager under Tenant Settings > API: https://cloud.loyjoy.com/.

actions.name: create_completion
actions.description: Generate completion text with a published LoyJoy process (agent).

processId.description: The ID of the published process used for the completion.

locale.description: The locale used for generation, such as en or de.

inputSchema.description: Input for generating text with a published LoyJoy process.

actions.name: get_process
actions.description: Retrieve a published LoyJoy process (agent) as JSON by its ID.

processId.description: The ID of the published process to retrieve.

inputSchema.description: Input for retrieving a LoyJoy process.

process.description: A LoyJoy process (agent) returned by the API.

actions.name: get_view
actions.description: Retrieve a LoyJoy home view as JSON by its ID.

viewId.description: The ID of the home view to retrieve.

inputSchema.description: Input for retrieving a LoyJoy home view.

view.description: A LoyJoy home view returned by the API.

actions.name: list_processes
actions.description: List the published LoyJoy processes (agents) available in the tenant.

inputSchema.description: No input is required to list LoyJoy processes.

items.description: A LoyJoy process (agent) returned by the API.

outputSchema.description: The published LoyJoy processes available in the tenant.

actions.name: list_views
actions.description: List the LoyJoy home views available in the tenant.

inputSchema.description: No input is required to list LoyJoy home views.

items.description: A LoyJoy home view returned by the API.

views.description: Home view records returned by LoyJoy.

outputSchema.description: The LoyJoy home views available in the tenant.

actions.name: search_chunks
actions.description: Search the tenant knowledge base for up to 100 relevant chunks.

folders.description: Folder names used to restrict the knowledge search.

maxChunks.description: The maximum number of chunks to return, up to 100.

inputSchema.description: Input for searching LoyJoy knowledge chunks.

items.description: A knowledge chunk returned by LoyJoy search.

outputSchema.description: Knowledge chunks matching the search query.

actions.name: start_process
actions.description: Start a published LoyJoy process and return the variables produced before it completes or requests user input.

processId.description: The ID of the published process to start.

variables.description: Process variables keyed by the variable names configured in LoyJoy.

inputSchema.description: Input for starting a published LoyJoy process.

variables.description: The process variables returned by LoyJoy.

outputSchema.description: The variables returned after starting the LoyJoy process.
